_help: Pipeline settings for the OSU Robotics Club rover (Rover_2026_2027). Use: mrc-urdf prepare rover.urdf --config urdf-pipeline/config/osu_rover.json
_fix_inertia: The URDF's drivetrain/body/camera inertias are 3-190x larger than their shapes allow; 15 are physically impossible (larger than with all the mass at the part's outer edge). CAD export error; reported upstream. Replace them with mesh-derived values.
_locked_joints: Each front side has a 'four-bar' (URDF comment: 'Four Bars Don't exist in URDF's'), but the commented-out back bogie joint puts the back bar's bogie pin at exactly the same point as the front bar's (to 6 decimals, both sides). Two bars meeting at one pin form a rigid triangle with the body: the links cannot move and the bogie pivots on that pin. So the link joints are locked; the bogie joints stay free (URDF limits +-15 deg, damping 2.0), like the rear bogie.
